أنبغي (form VII)
# أَنْبَغِي (ʔanbaḡī) /ʔan.ba.ɣiː/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْبَغَى (inbaḡā)
# أَنْبَغِيَ (ʔanbaḡiya) /ʔan.ba.ɣi.ja/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْبَغَى (inbaḡā)
